_AI_AGENT_INSTRUCTIONS: 1. Read the OFFICIAL rules, submission requirements, judging criteria and prize pages of the user's hackathon (URLs or pasted text supplied by the user). Never invent a rule: if a value is not stated, keep the default below and say so to the user.
2. Copy this file to <submission_folder>/hackathon_settings.json and replace the values. Keys that start with '_' are documentation and are ignored by the tool; you may delete them.
3. Any key you OMIT falls back to the NASA Space Apps 2026 default shown here. For a non-NASA hackathon, set every field explicitly (use null or [] to disable a gate).
4. gates.max_slides: integer slide limit for a PDF/PPTX demo, or null for no limit (NASA = 7, many Devpost hackathons = 15 or null).
5. gates.max_video_sec: maximum demo video length in seconds, or null for no limit (NASA = 30.0, Devpost often = 180.0, ETHGlobal often = 240.0).
6. gates.require_demo_file: true if a slide deck or video demo is mandatory for eligibility, false otherwise.
7. gates.required_language: ISO 639-1 code the submission text must be written in (e.g. 'en', 'fr'), or null to accept any language.

8. gates.required_keywords: lowercase sponsor / dataset / technology keywords the submission text MUST mention (case-insensitive substring match, at least 1 hit required). Use [] when the hackathon has no mandatory sponsor or dataset: gate G-06 then PASSES automatically and never blocks eligibility. The 22-term NASA list below is only correct for NASA Space Apps.
9. gates.require_references / gates.require_ai_disclosure: true only if the rules make a References section or an AI-usage disclosure mandatory.

10. criteria: the K official judging criteria in the hackathon's own words (1 to 10 items). Each is scored 1-5, so the total is /5K (5 criteria = /25, 4 criteria = /20). Put the official 'what a top score looks like' wording in description.
11. awards: exact names of the official prizes / tracks (judges must pick from this list), or [] when there is no official list (judges may then propose any category).
12. Validate the result is strict JSON (double quotes, no trailing commas, no comments) before saving.

_FIELD_GUIDE.hackathon_name: Display name used in prompts and in the report title, e.g. 'ETHGlobal Online 2026', 'Devpost Gen AI Hackathon', 'My Custom Hackathon'.
_FIELD_GUIDE.gates: Eligibility gates G-04..G-08 checked deterministically (no LLM) inside the Wave 1 probe VM.
_FIELD_GUIDE.criteria: List of {name, description}. Names are copied verbatim into the judge JSON schema and the report.
_FIELD_GUIDE.awards: List of strings. Empty list = free-form award fit, nothing is rejected for its award name.

criteria.name: Impact
criteria.description: Addresses a minor or major problem; reach, inspiration and effectiveness of the proposed solution.

criteria.name: Creativity
criteria.description: Originality and innovation: a novel concept or a meaningful improvement upon existing ideas.

criteria.name: Validity
criteria.description: Grounded in scientific principles; technically, functionally and logically feasible; usable.

criteria.name: Relevance
criteria.description: Fully addresses the challenge and integrates NASA data as a core component, not a superficial add-on.

criteria.name: Presentation
criteria.description: Clear, engaging, well-structured communication of the challenge, solution and significance (demo + project).
